notes.title: Version 1.7 Release Notes
notes.content:
Hello explorers, Today we are releasing Version 1.7 The Charm Update!

Charms are an all new system added to the game to improved progression and encourage more varied play styles!

This Update adds 8 charms that can be purchased with in game gold from the charm shop, The Charms Include
-Double Gold, Earn double gold from all sources,
-Golden Guns, Double damage to all weapons,
-Hand to hand, Increased melee damage,
-Defense Shield, Decreased damage taken,
-Reload Protection, Reloading causes an explosion you are immune to that kills nearby enemies,
-Ammo Boxes, Reloading has a chance to not take reserve ammo,
-Bleeding Box, Taking damage drops a bomb you are immune to that kills nearby enemies,
-Ricocheting bullets, Bullets will ricochet once off of any surface (you are immune to ricocheting bullets).


This Update also fixes some minor bugs, final boss issues, and improves the dungeons you explore!

As always we hope you enjoy and if the update isn't available restart your steam client!

Be well Explorers.

notes.title: Release 1.5 - The Classic Update
notes.content:
Hello explorers! 1.5 update, the Classic update, is live.

This update adds some of our own spin on the classic game play and effects that we loved from older twin stick games.  

Here is the run down of the updates.

Added - damage values will appear when you deal damage to an enemy.
Added - enemys will now drop gold.
Added - minibosses will now drop gold.
Added - more gold to end game room.
Added - picking up health while you're at max will give you gold.
Added - picking up grenades while you're at max will give you gold.
Added - breakables can now drop gold.
Added - breakables can now spawn on floor tiles not just aginst walls.
Added - Treasure Chest can now drop gold.
Added - treasure box, new ground treasure. 
Added - five new rune floor tiles with special propertys
	- these rune tiles have a chance to spawn, chest, tombs, gold, or traps
Added - damage variation, damage will now randomize slightly.
Added - random critical, all bullets have a chance of randomly causing a critical hit, doubling the damage.
Added - direction signs to hub world.
Added - press use text to open to chest.
Added - press use text to open to tomb.
Added - lights to dangerous objects.
Added - new attack to alograth.
	- stomp, this attack will cause rocks to fall from the cave ceiling. 

Nerfed - Dessert Eagle mag size upgrade, 1 bullet preupgrade.
Nerfed - pumpkin spawn rate to 0.025%
Nerfed - scarecrow spawn rate 0.035%
Nerfed - scarecrow_02 spawn rate 0.05%

Changed - lava traps visual FX
Changed - lava traps visual design.
Changed - lava traps wait to damage from 0.25 seconds to 0.15 seconds.
Changed - all players melee attacks are 125% stronger.
Changed - all pickups will now fly to the player rather then staying where they spawned.
Changed - well of souls spawnrate 0.085% - 0.2%
Changed - spike trap spawnrate 0.1% to 0.2%
Changed - floor pots spawn rate 0.02% - 0.075%
Changed - explosive barrel spawnrate 0.05% - 0.065%
Changed - skeleton spawn rate 0.3% - 0.4%
Changed - warrior spawn rate 0.1% - 0.2%
Changed - fire shamen spawn 0.06% 0.04%
Changed - total enemy spawns by 15%

Fixed - end gold count breaking.
Fixed - not being able to save a weapon to weapon slot 1.
Fixed - gadgets not saving
Fixed - greed tile chest spawning in ground.
Fixed - creates spawning in stairs.
Fixed - barrels spawning in stairs.
Fixed - pots spawning in stairs,
Fixed - explosive spawning in stairs.
Fixed - vines spawning in stairs.
Fixed - some small problems in the alograth boss chamber.

Alogarth has been unchained, be prepared explorers.

Keep the suggestions coming as we look forward to hearing them.

Until next time explorers, be well.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Say hello to the new "Grenades and Gadgets" Shop. Patch 1.1 is live!

Additions:
[list]
[*]New store opening "Grenades and Gadgets"
[list]
[*]New Smoke grenades, to hide from some enemy types, available for purchase
[*]New Time Bomb, to leave an explosive present behind, available for purchase 
[*]New Claymore, to provide for a defensive strategy, available for purchase
[*]New Drone for additional fire support available for purchase
[/list]
[*]Two (2) new silenced weapons will be available for purchase in the "Weapons Shop". Silenced weapons will not alert as many enemies to your presence
[list]
[*]Silenced USP
[*]Silenced UMP45
[/list]
[*]Underlying code to prepare for future enhancements
[/list]

We have also fixed:
[list]
[*]"Charger" enemy was not doing consistent damage
[*]An obscure set of actions in the "Weapons Shop" could soft lock the game
[/list]

As always the store purchases are based on gold you earned by finding treasure in the levels and opening Tombs and Chests that may contain precious artifacts. There are no real money nor microtransaction options available in our game.

We hope these new items will add to your enjoyment. Please reach out to us if you have complaints, concerns or compliments.

Be well explorers.

notes.title: Upcoming 1.1 patch
notes.content:
Welcome explorers to our latest entry to our Dev Diary.

It's been a busy few weeks, but we are just about ready to add some new content for your enjoyment. Patch 1.1 is just around the corner and we thought you might like to have a preview.

In this patch we have added :
[list]
[*] New store opening "Grenades and Gadgets"
[list]
[*]New Smoke grenades, to hide from some enemy types, available for purchase
[*]New Time Bomb, to leave an explosive present behind, available for purchase 
[*]New Claymore, to provide for a defensive strategy, available for purchase
[*]New Drone for additional fire support available for purchase
[/list]
[*] Two (2) new silenced weapons will be available for purchase in the "Weapons Shop". Silenced weapons will not alert as many enemies to your presence
[list]
[*]Silenced USP
[*]Silenced UMP45
[/list]
[*]Underlying code to prepare for future enhancements
[/list]

We have also fixed:
[list]
[*] "Charger" enemy was not doing consistent damage
[*] An obscure set of actions in the "Weapons Shop" could soft lock the game
[/list]

As always the store purchases are based on gold you earned by finding treasure in the levels and opening Tombs and Chests to find precious artifacts. So get exploring now to get your gold reserves up!

We expect to have this patch available by Sunday 6:00 pm EDT and will report back when it is available.

Until our next entry, be well explorers.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Patch 1.02 contains the following updates.

The chest and tomb openings are working as expected with controllers.

The player will no longer get stuck in a slide walk after opening a chest or tomb with a controller.

The player will no longer load the wrong weapons if the player cancels the weapon selection screen.

Improvemeants to bullet hit detection on the mini Bosses.

A new welcome message is displayed in the hub world to help clear up some confusion when the game is paused. 

Some small changes to the weapon shop to improve performance.
